fields.description: Monotonic revision of persisted sheet settings used for optimistic concurrency control.
fields.label: Settings Revision

fields.description: Records that this sheet's cut was placed before an internal operation. It does not waive later generation checks.
fields.label: Cut Path Early Confirmation

fields.description: Whether the outer CUT_PATH network is executed as one connected perimeter for this sheet.
fields.label: Perimeter Join Mode

fields.description: Optional execution order of CUT_PATH path keys when the sheet perimeter is connected.
fields.label: Cut Path Sequence

fields.description: Records that the connected sheet perimeter may run before the other CUT_PATH paths. It does not waive later generation checks.
fields.label: Perimeter Cut Early Confirmation

fields.description: CNC machine bed selected for this sheet. Coordinates stay bottom-left origin with X right and Y up.
fields.label: CNC Machine

fields.description: Distance from the machine left edge to the sheet left edge, in centimetres.
fields.label: Offset from Left (cm)

fields.description: Distance from the machine bottom edge to the sheet bottom edge, in centimetres.
fields.label: Offset from Bottom (cm)

fields.description: Sheet stop sides and distances. Empty keeps the machine sides and the full gap. This does not change the CNC Machine.
fields.label: Sheet Stops

fields.description: Historical post processor used when this file was saved. New NC uses the post processor on the CNC machine.
fields.label: Post Processor

fields.description: Independent profile copies. Editing one does not change the tool definition or another profile.
fields.label: Machining Profiles

fields.description: Vector assignments and their local profile copies.
fields.label: Vector Associations

fields.description: Frozen toolpath snapshots. Later tool or profile edits do not rewrite them.
fields.label: Toolpath Snapshots

fields.description: Path keys whose machining direction is reversed. Hidden preview state is not stored here.
fields.label: Reversed Path Keys

fields.description: Settings fingerprint of the last successfully generated NC file. The NC text is not stored.
fields.label: NC Generation Fingerprint

fields.description: Content hash of the last successfully generated NC file. The NC text is not stored.
fields.label: NC Generation Hash

fields.description: Legacy NC attachment reference retained only for audited cleanup; new exports are never stored.
fields.label: Legacy Generated File

fields.description: Legacy NC generation snapshot retained only until the related legacy attachments are audited and cleaned.
fields.label: Legacy Generation Snapshot
